message:
[ty] Avoid unnecessary work when building specializations (#28369)

## Summary

Filling missing generic arguments first constructs fallback types for
every parameter, then overwrites supplied arguments and defaults. We now
fill arguments in one pass, constructing fallbacks only when needed.
Defaults still see the completed prefix of earlier arguments, so
dependent defaults retain their substitution order.

We also skip expanding-cycle detection when there is at most one pending
mapping: self references are not followed, so an expanding cycle
requires at least two mappings.

[CodSpeed
Simulation](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/runs/101546864573) reports
+5.37% efficiency for `inherited_recursive_protocol_constructor` and
+5.32% for `inherited_recursive_protocol_diagnostic`, compared with
`0587598`.
